text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san's footwork is always so cool to watch.
As expected of a Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to be like Air Groove-san too...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And so... from here—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Mmm, this is so tough...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
There's this one step I just can't get right...
Even though I've watched the video so many times...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right,
let's give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...And from here—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hoh, those steps look familiar.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! A-Air Groove-san!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why that step? Weren't you
told to come up with original choreography?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Of course, I come up with the choreography
myself. ...But, no matter what...
I really wanted to include this one step...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Watching Air Groove-san dance from the audience,
she was always so gorgeous... I've admired her for so long."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I thought... if only I could
sparkle and shine like that, too..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………
...The fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Put emotion all the way through to your fingertips.
Your footwork is sloppy too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
......Amazing... So beautiful.
Her fingers are stretched taut yet graceful...
And her footwork is so smooth...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is your turn.
I shall see if you have mastered it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes!
I-I-It's a p-pleasure to work with you!

Rhein Kraft's tension is apparent.
I need to help her focus on dancing right now.
choice_data_list: Extend your awareness all the way to your fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Understood, I'll pay close attention to my fingertips while dancing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Like a flower—blooming gently in all its glory.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I... It is finished!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your subtle movements have become much more refined.
Well done.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you so much!
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's true...
I'll review the steps one more time
before trying to dance it again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Do this... and then that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-It's ready!
It feels unreal considering how much I was stumbling just a moment ago!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
You're a quick learner.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your guidance!
